review:
Tramp Day Trueways continues the tramp's rags-to-riches story on Trueways reels. It adds a Coin Respin event to the original's free spins.

Chance x2 increases your odds of triggering features, which matters more here because it now feeds two bonuses. BGaming rates it very high volatility with a 5,000x maximum and a 96.7% RTP. Free spins arrive about once every 229 spins. It uses the same maths as Olympus Trueways and Wild West Trueways, with a quirky urban theme.
pros: Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
